import "golang.org/x/term"

func GetTerminalSize() (int, int) {
	fd := int(os.Stdin.Fd())
	width, height, err := term.GetSize(fd)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("Failed to obtain terminal size: %v\n", err)
	}
	return width, height
}

func CalcCenter() (int, int, int, int) {
	w, h := GetTerminalSize()
	cw := w / 2
	ch := h / 2
	return w, h, cw, ch
}
